posts.text: GIFT Nifty just did $23.67 BILLION in a single day! — GIFT Nifty hit a fresh all-time high on September 25 with $23.67 billion (~₹2.27 lakh crore) in single-day turnover, across 5.12 lakh contracts. Open interest also hit a record $21.87 billion. 2026-09-28_14-46 1033×862 250 KB I think the bigger story here isn’t just the $23.67B headline. It’s how quickly GIFT Nifty is becoming a serious venue for global investors to express views on Indian markets.
